IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Thursday, August 6, 2026**

**LU-291 Boise, ID** is running hot with 95 calls across four contractors hammering the Micron ID1 fab. Prime Controls, VECA, Quality, and EC Electric are all posting **$45.33/hr** but here's the move: per diem runs **$170/day for seven days if eligible**, plus **$20/hr** on top—that's real money for a swing shift gig. Book depth is clean. This is data center adjacent industrial, not your typical babysit-a-panel work.

**LU-430 Racine, WI** has 53 calls stacked on the Microsoft Mount Pleasant project alone. Four contractors (Gerdes, Pieper, Staff, Kelso Burnett) are all pulling at **$62.51/hr**—solid scale, and the work started late June so crews are locked in. Wisconsin JW or reciprocal required; long sleeves and conduit bending non-negotiable.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** shows 39 calls with three Cupertino and MJ Electric gigs all hitting the Port Washington Data Center. **JW wage plus $10/hr** premium, 50–60 hour weeks, and Job #192, #265, and #041 are REPOST flags—meaning turnover and available slots. These aren't backfills; they're expansion calls.

**LU-401 Reno, NV** has 47 calls with Bechtel on Thacker Pass (Winnemucca) at **$57.06/hr** base, **6-10s**, **$30/day per diem**, Workforce Hub open. Baker, Bombard, and Briggs Electric are all subbing solar and campus work at the same scale. All OT double time. Report dates already posted.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** is chasing 97 calls split between Parsons and Hunt Electric on Polaris Forge and Air Base work. **$44.80/hr**, **$100–150/day incentive** (non-taxed), **6-10s or 4-10s**, GPS radius 100+ miles. The per diem structure is tight but the hours are guaranteed.

Data center and fab construction are pulling hands nationally—book depth shrinking across every region posting $45+.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Thursday, August 6, 2026**

**LU-291 Boise, ID** is running hot with 26 calls and ~148 hands on the books. Four contractors (Prime Controls, VECA Electric, EC Electric, Quality Electric Inc.) are stacked with **$45.33/hr Inside JW work** at the Micron Idaho facility — that's PLA work with **$170/day per diem** (7 days if eligible) and 4-10 swing shifts. The scale gap between book rate (**$65.33**) and actual calls is wide, but the per diem makes the math work for transients. Book depth is tight.

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** has 46 calls screaming for bodies. New River Electric Corp. is the anchor — 40 JW Lineman spots on distribution work with **$125/day per diem**, a **$125 bonus on 10-hour days**, and 6-10 schedules. CDL required. Southern Ohio satellite calls run 4-10s. Capital Electric Line in Johnstown is hunting cable-splicing experience. Book sits at ~140 hands, so there's movement.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** — 23 calls, 138 hands — is the dark horse. Parsons Electric has 97 Inside JW spots split across two call lines at the Polaris Forge Data Center (Harwood). **$44.80/hr + $100/day non-taxed per diem**, plus **$100/day incentive Mon–Fri, $150 Sat/Sun**. That's 6-10s with real money stacked on weekends. Hunt Electric and Northern Valley have Air Base work at the same scale. GPS radius is 100+ miles.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** shows 9 calls feeding 78 hands. Summit Line, Cupertino Electric, and B&D Industries are calling **$55/hr** (NM State JIW License EE98J required) with **all OT double time**. Fire Alarm/VESDA chops preferred. Rosendin is the outlier at **$40 + $15 incentive** for TX-licensed JI work.

**LU-70 Forestville, MD** — 11 calls, 51 hands — is referral-heavy distro work: LU 456 (Wayne) into Burlington/Sewaren, NJ with **$175/day per diem**; LU 126 (Charley) into PA with **$150/day**. Didado's transmission gig in Oldfield, WV hits **$126/hr + $150/day**. Tight book, good rates.

The data centers—Polaris Forge in ND, Micron in Idaho, DNN4 in Tennessee—are pulling hands from older distro boards. Incentive pay and stacked per diems are the bait.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Thursday, August 6, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is running the thickest board of the week — 18 calls, 61 hands needed. BCS Mechanical's got the anchor: 15 JW Pipefitters and 13 JW Plumbers on the Sego Project (West Valley), all locked into 4-10s, 6 AM–4:30 PM with OT baked in, started Aug 3. DSI's QTS data center in Eagle Mountain is tighter: 6 JW Pipefitters, 5-8s but jumping to 5-10s plus a Saturday 8, though the posted rate shows $10.00 (likely placeholder data). Apprentices available too if you're still climbing the ladder. This is volume work — not sexy, but steady.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** is Intel territory. 21 calls across 30 hands — the second-biggest board. Charter Mechanical wants 4 Orbital Welders for tool install on Intel Ronler Acres (Hillsboro); PermaCold's pushing 3 Commercial Refrigeration Service Techs in the Portland metro. BIM Detailer slots are open too if you've got the CAD chops. No posted premium rates, but Intel jobs historically hold.

**LU-213 St. John, NB** is industrial refinery and pulp-mill work. Stuart Olson and CAM are split across Irving Oil Refinery and Irving Pulp & Paper Mill — 3 JW Pipefitters per call, day and night shifts, GPMA short-term contracts with D&A testing required. PD rates not specified, but Maritime industrial work typically compensates travel.

**LU-525 Las Vegas, NV** has one call: 12 Journeymen for Four Seasons towers in Henderson starting 7/30 (already live). OSHA 10/30 card mandatory. Light board, but move fast.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** is federal: Ellsworth AFB and Fort Meade VA, $100/day per diem, OSHA 10 and background checks required. Combo welders and plumbers both needed.

**Bottom line:** Salt Lake's volume play is eating the market; Intel's Portland tier holding steady; industrial refinery work in the Maritimes filling quick.
